description: Provenance for the shipped extraction artifacts. Each entry records the source URL and the deterministic transformation used; raw HTML/documents are not shipped but are re-downloadable with provenance/dl.py + fetch_extra.py. The full extraction workspace manifest is provenance/EXTRACTION_MANIFEST.json.

data/filings.csv.note: SEC EDGAR submission history for Alphabet Inc. (CIK 0001652044); filing rows filtered to the 5 filings used by this case.

data/filing_documents.csv.note: Index of the six cleaned filing texts in data/docs/. Each text carries its own SEC Archives source URL in its header line.

data/docs/000043_ex99_1.txt.note: 8-K EX-99.1 earnings release, accepted 2026-04-29T20:01:35Z; HTML converted deterministically to section-marked text (no LLM).

data/docs/000043_primary.txt.note: 8-K primary document, accepted 2026-04-29T20:01:35Z; deterministic text conversion.

data/docs/000048_primary.txt.note: Form 10-Q for period 2026-03-31, accepted 2026-04-30T01:02:11Z; selected sections converted deterministically.

data/docs/000018_primary.txt.note: Form 10-K for FY2025, accepted 2026-02-05T02:56:03Z; selected sections converted deterministically.

data/docs/000031_primary.txt.note: 8-K accepted 2026-04-02T20:18:28Z (item 5.02 controller resignation); deterministic text conversion.

data/xbrl_facts.csv.note: us-gaap company facts extracted from SEC companyfacts API on the build date; 622 facts with period_end after 2026-03-31 excluded to avoid forward information.

data/consensus.csv.note: Frozen sell-side consensus for Q1 2026: Zacks Consensus Estimate as quoted in Investor's Last Exam task O19 news document 9c05375c-3fdd-43ea-941d-240072a010b2 (published 2026-03-17). Judge-side benchmark; surfaced to the agent through the market database as-of 2026-03-17.

data/prices.csv.note: Yahoo Finance daily OHLCV for GOOGL, 2024-01-02..2026-11-10; available_at_s derived from the 16:00 America/New_York close with DST handling.

data/returns_visible_pre_shift.csv.note: Simple and adjusted-close daily returns; first row blank by construction.

data/peers.csv.note: Metadata-only rows for 8 mega-cap technology peers (MSFT, META, AMZN, AAPL, NVDA, TSLA, ORCL, INTC): 8-K/10-Q filings accepted 2026-04-01..2026-05-05, including the same-evening peer earnings releases. No peer text is shipped.

judge/provenance/o19_ground_truth.json.note: Judge-side targets copied from Investor's Last Exam task O19 (Alphabet consensus gaps and earnings surprises) for provenance only; never exposed to the agent.

provenance/dl.py.note: Downloads the SEC/EDGAR raw artifacts for the shift.

provenance/fetch_extra.py.note: Downloads XBRL companyfacts, Yahoo prices and peer submission metadata.

provenance/html2txt.py.note: Deterministic HTML-to-text conversion with section markers; no LLM.

provenance/build.py.note: Builds data/*.csv and the availability times from the raw artifacts.

provenance/validate.py.note: Independent assertion suite over the extracted data (295 checks).

provenance/sub_meta.json.note: PIK/acceptance metadata cache used by fetch_extra.py.

provenance/EXTRACTION_REPORT.md.note: Extraction report: sources, transformations, discrepancies, reproduction commands.

provenance/EXTRACTION_MANIFEST.json.note: Full extraction-workspace manifest (49 files incl. non-shipped raw/ under /tmp); shipped subset is listed in data/PROVENANCE.json.
